subject.title: [Control UI] 部分模块中文翻译缺失

question: Should maintainers treat this as a coordinated Control UI zh-CN localization umbrella with module-by-module PRs, or defer broad module localization until a single generated sweep is sponsored?
rationale: The source gaps are real, but the remaining work spans many UI surfaces and generated locale outputs, and multiple partial PRs already overlap.

options.title: Coordinate focused module PRs
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and review the existing partial PRs after aligning them with the i18n generation pipeline.

options.title: Sponsor one generated sweep
options.body: Pause the partial PRs and ask for one maintainer-owned sweep that extracts English keys, runs i18n sync, and proves zh-CN coverage across the reported tabs.

options.title: Defer full tab localization
options.body: Leave only critical strings in scope for now and close or narrow the broader module-completeness request.

recommendation.title: Coordinate focused module PRs
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and review the existing partial PRs after aligning them with the i18n generation pipeline.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest merged-history signal across Control UI i18n repair and adjacent localization work.
